description_en: Queries the list of intelligent alert events for vehicle operations
description_zh: 调用该接口查询车辆作业的智能告警事件列表
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual query-car-process-events --iot-instance-id iotx-oxsshare0000 --sub-iot-id ImP6ECd1aQ0000CAfWTO000101 --sub-product-key a1Duh0F0000 --sub-device-name car_test --begin-time 1646288487368 --end-time 1646288488368 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --plate-no '浙AM0000' --action-type 2 --area-index 1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryCarProcessEvents

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no<props="intl"><ph> Overview page or</ph></props> ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html operation of IoT Platform to query this ID.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey and DeviceName. IotId is the unique identifier of the device and has a one-to-one mapping with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: sub_iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation to view information about all products under the current account.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: sub_product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the IPC device.
You can view the DeviceName on the Devices page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: sub_device_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query range. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围起始时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query range. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围结束时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。页数从1开始排序
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 20. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数。最小值为1，最大值为20，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The license plate number. A maximum of 15 characters is supported
parameters.help_zh: 车牌号码。最大支持输入15个字符
parameters.name: plate_no

parameters.help_en:
The action type of the vehicle. Valid values:

1: entering
2: staying
3: leaving
parameters.help_zh:
车辆的动作类型，包含以下三种类型：

1：进入
2：停留
3：离开
parameters.name: action_type

parameters.help_en: The detection box of the IPC device. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69584.html operation to query the number of detection boxes. Set identifier to QueryAlgoTaskDetails
parameters.help_zh: IPC设备的检测框。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69584.html查询检测框数量。其中**identifier**设置为**QueryAlgoTaskDetails**
parameters.name: area_index
